scorecard.rationale: No controlled comparison against an inactive control isolates cold-pressed flaxseed oil for constipation severity. The registered hemodialysis trial (NCT02103556, PMID25238699) compared flaxseed, olive, and active laxative mineral oil (n=50) and found an inconclusive between-oil interaction (p=.15) with unverified pressing grade; a lipid trial (sjams.2018.v06i01.047) logged 2/57 vs 5/55 constipation adverse events against liquid paraffin without severity scoring; plasma ALA was unrelated to Wexner constipation (PMID34127758); and petroleum-ether extracted oil gave a nonmonotonic rodent wet-stool response. Consistent with claim 0072, the claim moves from legacy 51 to open.
